pain_point: Commute and location concerns - I need something close to the freeway and port — Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?
primary_text: "Is it too far west?" Here's a question back — how far is too far when you own the building? Truganina connects you to the Princes Freeway in minutes. The West Gate Tunnel puts Melbourne CBD within reach. The Port of Melbourne is a short run south. You get a brand-new warehouse built to your specs, in a booming industrial precinct, at entry-level pricing. The businesses paying premium rent in Laverton and Sunshine are watching Truganina values climb. Will you own here, or wish you had?
description: Entry-level pricing in Melbourne's fastest-appreciating industrial zone
